hero.headline: Invest in the vision.
hero.description: Lawn-A-Mercy Landscaping is building from an owner-led Lawrenceville service business into a scalable, recognizable local property-care brand.

why_invest.title: Branded fleet growth
why_invest.body: Expand capacity with distinctive trucks, trailers, tools, and field systems that make the brand recognizable on every route.

why_invest.title: Repeat local demand
why_invest.body: Recurring lawn and property-care work creates an opportunity to build durable customer relationships across residential and small-business properties.

why_invest.title: Scalable service mix
why_invest.body: Mowing, cleanup, mulch, trimming, pressure washing, and property touch-ups create multiple ways to serve the same customer.

why_invest.title: Owner-led brand
why_invest.body: A community-rooted service identity built around direct communication, visible workmanship, and a memorable island-inspired brand.

fleet.title: Truck + enclosed trailer
fleet.description: High-visibility truck and enclosed trailer concept with organized equipment storage and strong neighborhood branding.

fleet.title: Enclosed service truck
fleet.description: A self-contained branded service body designed around clean organization, fast access, and professional presentation.

fleet.title: Open-rack efficiency rig
fleet.description: Mobile rack system that keeps trimmers, blowers, tank, and daily-use tools visible and fast to reach.

fleet.title: Van + compact trailer
fleet.description: Versatile urban/suburban setup for tight driveways, smaller properties, and a polished high-visibility presence.

use_of_funds.title: Equipment & fleet
use_of_funds.body: Acquire, repair, and upgrade trucks, trailers, mowers, tanks, and field tools.

use_of_funds.title: Wraps & branding
use_of_funds.body: Build a consistent visual system across fleet, uniforms, print, signs, and customer touchpoints.

use_of_funds.title: Customer acquisition
use_of_funds.body: Support local marketing, referral systems, neighborhood visibility, and digital lead capture.

use_of_funds.title: Staffing & training
use_of_funds.body: Add dependable field capacity and codify repeatable service standards as routes grow.

use_of_funds.title: Systems & operations
use_of_funds.body: Improve scheduling, estimating, customer records, inventory, reporting, and Trio-connected operations.

disclaimer: This page presents Lawn-A-Mercy Landscaping's operating vision and is not an offer to sell securities or a promise of returns. Any investment opportunity would require separate written terms and appropriate legal and financial review.
